steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: You're finally awake... I've been waiting for you this whole time.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: You don't look well. Did you have a nightmare? Tell me, what did you dream about?
Don't listen to her! This is an attack targeted at you!
On one side of the recovery pod, several researchers were squashed into the wall. The only conscious person is shouting at you desperately.

steps.speaker: Trapped Researcher
steps.content: Chief, don't leave the repair pod!  If you don't complete the repair program, your mind will be... Mmm——Mmm——!!!
Amid violent tremors, the man's face and voice are devoured by a formless darkness, falling into absolute silence.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Great, now stand up. We've got a lot to do.
The bullets keep coming ceaselessly. With a few grunts, the woman before you collapsed onto you before she even had time to twitch once.
A series of rapid footsteps soon burst into the room.
